$schema_note: Local snapshot of the agentskills.io open specification used by skill-publish.sh + agentskills-validator.sh. Regenerate by re-running the firecrawl-scrape of https://agentskills.io/specification — see snapshot_provenance below.

regeneration_steps: Re-read the Frontmatter table; if any field's Required/Constraints column changed, update frontmatter_schema below
Update spec_version (semver bump) if any breaking change in required fields

constraints.regex_description: Lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens. No leading/trailing/consecutive hyphens.

constraints.should_describe: Both what the skill does and when to use it (trigger keywords)

constraints.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file
Environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access, etc.)
Arbitrary key-value mapping for additional metadata not defined by the Agent Skills spec

agentskills_compatible.purpose: Declares the skill is intended to comply with the agentskills.io open spec. Used by build-skill-index.sh to set the agentskills_compatible field at index time.

version.purpose: Semver version of the skill itself (independent of any plugin version).

category.purpose: High-level category used by the progressive-disclosure index.

tags.purpose: Searchable tags for discovery via skill index.

platforms.purpose: OS scope. Defaults to [macos, linux] at index time.

constraints.description: Space-separated string of tools pre-approved to run. Support varies between agent implementations.

frontmatter_schema.forbidden_prefix_description: Vendor-extension namespace check. Any top-level frontmatter key starting with _private_ is rejected by the validator. Use metadata.* for vendor-specific extensions instead.
